# Copilot Instructions for Fabrica

Agent directives for this repository live in **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** at the repository
root. That file is vendor-neutral — Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor all read it — so it
is the single source of truth. Read it before making any change.

This file deliberately duplicates none of it. VS Code loads every always-on instruction file
with no guaranteed precedence, so two overlapping files would drift apart with no defined winner.
